Mahindra Launches Updated Thar OG with Enhanced Features

Mahindra has launched the updated Thar OG, featuring a more powerful engine and enhanced off-road capabilities. The 2026 Thar now offers a 2.2-liter diesel engine option with a 4-wheel drive (4WD) automatic variant for the first time. It also includes new suspension, electronic locking differential, and 4WD modes designed to improve performance in challenging conditions like mud and snow. The price starts at ₹10.32 lakh.
